cards.name: Summer Funshine Day Camp
cards.description: Campers with developmental disabilities participate in games, arts and crafts, music, dancing, water activities and entertainment. Each camper must be accompanied by an adult family member or assistant.

prices.label: There is no cost to campers!

special_needs.text: Funshine Camp was created with one heartfelt mission: to offer meaningful recreational and educational experiences to individuals of all ages with developmental disabilities--at absolutely no cost to them or their families.

cards.review_notes: The 2026 summer venue is stated by Higgins Methodist's May 20, 2026 volunteer announcement, not by the provider's summer camp page. The provider publishes the same venue's address for seasonal parties as 6553 HWY 19E; Higgins prints 6553 US Hwy 19. Confirm the summer drop-off location directly. Eligibility is stated as all ages, with no numeric age limits. Adult accompaniment is required.
